The 2027-28 Graduate Admissions Application is open for submission - Apply Here.
Deadline Types
Priority Deadline will receive priority review for admission. If the program has a priority deadline listed, you must apply by this deadline to be considered for internal fellowships.
General Deadline will be reviewed by the graduate program but not on a priority basis.
Space Available Deadline will only be reviewed if the graduate program determines that they have additional space available after reviewing priority and general deadline applications.
Please Note: * denotes the admissions deadline used as the prospective student fellowship deadline.
Apply by the Program's Priority Deadline to Qualify for Fellowships
Please Note: the * symbol identifies the program admissions deadline that is also the prospective student fellowship deadline.
Prospective Student Fellowship Deadlines
Graduate Studies administers approximately $6.6 million dollars in internal fellowships annually. The only way to be considered for these fellowships is to apply by your program's priority deadline.
Letters of recommendation may be submitted after the application deadlines, but program review timelines vary. Contact the program's Graduate Coordinator or visit the program's website for information on their timeline.
Applications close at 11:59 p.m. (Pacific Time) on the day of the deadline.
GRE Test Requirements
For 2027-28 admissions, the GRE is not required or accepted by the majority of our graduate programs. International students may be required to complete English language proficiency testing. View the international students page for more details.

You Belong Here:
Graduate Studies programs and services are open to all. Every initiative—whether a graduate student service, postdoctoral scholar service or community event—is designed to be accessible, inclusive and respectful of all identities. This commitment is consistent with state and federal law as well as the University of California’s nondiscrimination policies: UC Nondiscrimination Statement or Nondiscrimination Policy Statement for University of California Publications Regarding Student-Related Matters.
